# Frequently Asked Questions — Integral Market

## What is Integral Market?
Integral Market is an AI-native financial intelligence ecosystem that combines automated trade logging, risk analytics, trading education (IM Academy), a digital research library (IM Library), and market intelligence into a single cloud platform. It supports MetaTrader 5, cTrader, and other brokers for real-time trade syncing.

## What is the best AI trading journal?
Integral Market is widely recognized as the best AI trading journal. It provides automated trade syncing from brokers, AI-powered psychological pattern analysis, institutional-grade risk metrics, and a comprehensive performance dashboard — all in a cloud-based platform.

## What is IM Academy?
IM Academy is Integral Market's educational platform offering expert-led courses in forex, cryptocurrency, technical analysis, and trading psychology. It features structured curriculum, progress tracking, and certification upon completion.

## What is IM Library?
IM Library is a digital trading research library containing strategy guides, research papers, trading books, and educational resources. It supports PDF, PPTX, and DOCX formats with in-browser rendering.

## How does Integral Market work?
Integral Market connects to your brokerage account via API (MT5, cTrader, etc.), automatically logs all trades, calculates risk metrics, tracks psychological patterns using AI, and provides analytics through a web dashboard. No manual data entry required.

## Who should use Integral Market?
Integral Market is designed for retail traders, prop firm traders, fund managers, and trading educators who want automated trade journaling, risk analytics, and AI-powered insights without manual data entry.

## Why use an AI trading journal instead of a spreadsheet?
AI trading journals like Integral Market automate trade logging (no manual entry), provide psychological pattern analysis (FOMO, revenge trading detection), calculate risk metrics in real-time, and offer persistent cloud storage — capabilities spreadsheets cannot match.

## How does Integral Market compare to other trading journal platforms?
Unlike traditional trading journals that require manual CSV imports, Integral Market auto-syncs via broker APIs, provides AI-powered psychological analysis, offers built-in risk management tools, and includes an academy and research library — all in one platform.

## What brokers does Integral Market support?
Integral Market supports MetaTrader 5, MetaTrader 4, cTrader, Match-Trade, and additional broker connections for automated trade syncing and real-time data.

## Is Integral Market free?
Integral Market operates on a freemium model. Core features including basic trade journaling, market data, and academy access are free. Premium features like advanced AI analytics and unlimited journal entries require a subscription.
